name: unprose
description: A shared visual canvas where people and AI agents talk designs through — EventStorming, story maps, kanban, wireframes and workflows, each backed by a file the agent edits.

canvas_url.title: Canvas URL
canvas_url.description: Where the Unprose canvas runs. A local address (localhost / 127.0.0.1) is started for you and kept on the plugin's version; a remote one is only used, never started or stopped. A board link works too.

canvas_autostart.title: Start the canvas automatically
canvas_autostart.description: Start a local canvas at the start of each session and restart it on the new version after a plugin update. It never touches a canvas you started from outside the plugin.
